column1: # Pilot B -- the parameters of `_pesca_de_remate` and `_prob_al_menos`.
# These are API: main.py and the tests pass them BY KEYWORD, so the
# definition and every call site have to move in the same batch. Applied
# The `_PescaRemate` fields: the tests build the dataclass by keyword and
# read `plan.<field>`, so the class and its readers move together.
# `cartas` (the field holding how many Grass the draw must bring) is left
# out on purpose: it is also the name of the `ptcg/cartas` package and of
# unrelated locals elsewhere, so it needs a per-file rename, not a global
# one. It goes with the attribute phase.
